newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Telstra expects strong demand for franc bond.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Telstra expects strong demand for franc bond.

text.p: Australian telecoms group Telstra Corp said on Wednesday it expected strong demand for its 10-year 1.5 billion French franc Eurobond issued on Tuesday.

"I am confident that the issue will be well accepted by French investors because of Telstra's strong credit ratings and solid financial position," said Paul Rizzo, Teltra's Group Management Director, Finance & Adminstration.
The issue, which pays a 6.0 percent coupon, is rated AA/Aa2 by Standard & Poors and Moody's.

The bonds, which represented the first Australian corporate to enter the franc market, was swapped into Australian dollars. "The issue ... results in significant cost savings compared to domestic borrowing rates. It also lengthens Telstra's debt maturity profile, further diversifying our sources of finance, and improving access to funding," Rizzo said.

The issue was lead managed by BNP and J.P. Morgan with Merrill Lynch, Morgan Stanley, Paribas and Societe Generale acting as co-lead mangers. The proceeds will be used for general corporate funding and to refinance maturing debt.
